shared_elements: large wing rendered as stacked rows of feathers
human head in profile with headdress/cap
arm raised/extended in front of the body
circular disc/rosette motifs on the body or wing
single large figure dominating the field
justification: Both surfaces depict a single large winged humanoid seen in strict profile, with a capped/headdressed head, an arm brought forward, and wings articulated as tiered registers of long feathers, a specific and conventional combination unlikely to arise independently. The differences are that A adds prominent disc/rosette markings over the torso and wing and is a bare schematic outline, while B is a modelled relief with dense patterned garment detail and a band of inscribed signs across the field that A lacks.
